desc: Implement complete solution: adjacency list from edges, recursion-limited DFS from node 0 carrying prefix distance and depth.

Sliding-window state: `path` list (depth→node), `last` dict (value→depth), `left` boundary; on enter node advance left = max(left, last.get(val,-1)+1), save old entry, set last[val]=depth, append node.
Candidate evaluation per node: length = pref[-1] - pref[new_left], nodes = depth - new_left + 1; update best on greater length or equal length with fewer nodes.
Rollback on backtrack: pop path, restore last[val] to saved entry (or delete).

Validate: both provided examples, all-equal values → [0,1], deep chain (recursion limit), tie cases with equal length different node counts; trace through code logic to confirm correctness of pref indexing and left boundary handling.
